general.title: Credit's Bear Market Warning
general.summary: Credit markets are showing strain after years of tight spreads, as higher rates, a surge in AI-related borrowing, private-credit concerns and geopolitical risks converge. Pearlstone Alternative's Ivelina Green says credit is already in a bear market, with heavy AI debt supply adding pressure—and a widening gap between credit and equity sentiment that may not last. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Private Credit's Daily Marks Under Fire
general.summary: Monroe Capital CEO Ted Koenig says daily marks on illiquid private-credit assets create an illusion of precision, not accuracy. He discusses the deal slowdown, pressure on private-equity exits and why he's cautious about data centers and GPU lending. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: AI Spending Faces the Profit Test
general.summary: Goldman Sachs Chief US Equity Strategist Ben Snider says concentration in the Magnificent Seven could amplify risk as macro pressures build. Earnings remain strong, but rising costs are weighing on results. Investors are looking to defensive sectors, while the next phase of the AI trade depends on proof that heavy investment can deliver returns. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: AI Spending: Boom or Breaking Point?
general.summary: AI demand is surging, but will massive spending pay off? JPMorgan Asset Management's Gabriela Santos discusses free cash flow, quality, and the shift from building AI infrastructure to adopting it—and what that could mean for market winners, earnings and bonds. (Source: Bloomberg)
